contributions.detail: 3 Schedule A rows sum to 63.26 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 63.26 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed Total Contributions Received = the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell (Column A). Row 1 is the filer's own AGGREGATE line — date 'VARIOUS', contributor '< $50.00', address 'VARIOUS', amount 63.26 — kept as ONE row and never split into imagined donors. Rows 2 and 3 are the filer's category lines 'GOODS OR SERVICES' and 'IN KIND', each carrying a SLASHED ZERO in the amount cell, read 0 under the repo zero-glyph ruling; they contribute nothing to the sum but they are printed rows of the schedule and they are what makes the in-kind test decidable here. in_kind_convention: MONETARY-ONLY AND MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND ARE IDENTICAL HERE, AND THE FILER SAYS SO HIMSELF — tested both ways as the brief requires. Schedule A carries an explicit printed 'IN KIND' line whose amount is a SLASHED ZERO (0), and an explicit 'GOODS OR SERVICES' line likewise zero, so the in-kind component of this filing is stated to be nil and both conventions close at 63.26. This is the rare filing where the per-filer in-kind question is answered on the page instead of inferred from arithmetic.
